purpose: Verify workflow path from NO_SUBMITTED_REQUEST to AWAITING_SCHEDULING via SUBMIT event.
preconditions: Postgraduate student with no active pending seminar request.
action_or_input: Student initiates and submits graduate seminar request with valid details.
expected_result: State transitions to AWAITING_SCHEDULING; can_transition returns allowed=True.

purpose: Verify workflow path from AWAITING_SCHEDULING to SCHEDULED via SCHEDULE event by Department Administrator.
preconditions: Request in AWAITING_SCHEDULING exists. Department Administrator schedules the seminar.
action_or_input: Administrator performs SCHEDULE action with complete seminar details.
expected_result: State transitions to SCHEDULED (terminal success state); GraduateSeminar record is created.

purpose: Verify workflow path from AWAITING_SCHEDULING to REJECTED via REJECT event by Department Administrator.
preconditions: Request in AWAITING_SCHEDULING exists. Department Administrator decides to reject.
action_or_input: Administrator performs REJECT action with rejection reason.
expected_result: State transitions to REJECTED (terminal rejected state); rejection reason recorded.

purpose: Verify workflow path from AWAITING_SCHEDULING to CANCELLED via CANCEL event by student.
preconditions: Request in AWAITING_SCHEDULING exists. Request owner decides to withdraw.
action_or_input: Student executes CANCEL event on the pending request.
expected_result: State transitions to CANCELLED (terminal cancelled state).

purpose: Verify illegal transition attempt: Attempting to schedule an already SCHEDULED seminar is rejected.
preconditions: Request is in SCHEDULED terminal state.
action_or_input: Attempt to trigger SCHEDULE or SUBMIT event on this request.
expected_result: Workflow state machine refuses transition with can_transition returning allowed=False.

purpose: Verify illegal transition attempt: Attempting to schedule a REJECTED request is rejected.
preconditions: Request is in REJECTED terminal state.
action_or_input: Attempt to trigger SCHEDULE event on the rejected request.
expected_result: Workflow state machine refuses transition with can_transition returning allowed=False.

purpose: Verify workflow role guard: Student is unauthorized to execute the SCHEDULE or REJECT event.
preconditions: Request in AWAITING_SCHEDULING exists. Authenticated actor is student.
action_or_input: Student attempts to invoke SCHEDULE or REJECT action on the request.
expected_result: Action is refused by permission guard and status remains AWAITING_SCHEDULING.
